name: SD Coupon – Free Affiliate Discount Coupons Promo Code and Deals
author: Sadhan Pal

sections.description:
Top WordPress Coupon plugin to promote affiliate coupons on your WordPress site. Increase affiliate sales and generate more revenue.

Plugin Documentation: https://wordpress.org/plugins/sd-coupon

Live Demo

Key Features

  • Very simple.
  • Attractive shortcode.
  • Insert shortcode anywhere in the post.
  • Easy to use settings.
  • Searching advantage in the coupon dashboard.
  • Edit and delete facility for the existing coupons.
  • Coupon only reveal when click on the link.

[UPDATE] We promise updates at the right time

SD Coupons is a Coupon plugin that lets you add coupons, deals to your posts, pages with a simple and beautiful shortcode.

Video Tutorial

How To Use

After you have installed the plugin, you can will see a SD Coupons in your admin dashboard menu.
Click on it. Then there you will get all the advantages of this plugin.

  1. You can Add new coupon.
  2. You can edit and delete the existing coupons.
  3. You can search a specific coupon if you have thousands there!

You’re done!
sections.installation:
This is one way you can install and use the plugin:

  1. Install SD Coupon either via the WordPress.org plugin repository or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate SD Coupon.
  3. Go to ‘SD Coupon’ from the dashboard and manage your coupons.
sections.faq:
Who should use SD Coupon?

Bloggers and affiliate marketers who run wordpress website and need to hide the coupon code.

Do I need to have coding skills to use SD Coupon?

Absolutely not.

Coupon is not showing properly. What should I do?

Clear your cache and try again.
